title: VTX221-201 — 12-week antihypertensive dose-ranging trial (synthetic)
description: Fictional randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of VTX-221 10 mg and 20 mg once daily versus placebo in adults with essential hypertension (sponsor: Halden Therapeutics, fictional). Primary endpoint: change from baseline in seated systolic blood pressure at Week 12. Designed for teaching ANCOVA, repeated-measures (MMRM) analysis, missing data and safety summaries.

datasets.name: ADSL
datasets.label: Subject-Level Analysis Dataset
datasets.description: All randomized subjects (screen failures excluded): demographics, baseline characteristics, stratification, treatment, dates, disposition and population flags.

columns.name: USUBJID
columns.label: Unique Subject Identifier
columns.derivation: STUDYID || "-" || SUBJID.

columns.name: SUBJID
columns.label: Subject Identifier for the Study
columns.derivation: SITEID || "-" || three-digit sequence number within site (in order of randomization).

columns.name: SITEID
columns.label: Study Site Identifier
columns.notes: 12 fictional sites: 101–109 in the USA, 110–112 in Canada.

columns.name: AGE
columns.label: Age
columns.notes: Age in years at informed consent (inclusion: 30–80 years in this simulation).

columns.name: AGEGR1N
columns.label: Pooled Age Group 1 (N)
columns.derivation: 1 if AGEGR1 = "<65"; 2 if AGEGR1 = ">=65".

columns.name: RACE
columns.label: Race
columns.notes: Race/ethnicity terminology has been evolving in recent CDISC CT releases (RACEC/ETHNICC "as collected" codelists); the classic submission values are used here.

columns.name: BMIBL
columns.label: Baseline BMI (kg/m2)
columns.derivation: WEIGHTBL / (HEIGHTBL/100)**2, rounded to 1 decimal.

columns.name: DIABFL
columns.label: Type 2 Diabetes at Baseline Flag
columns.derivation: "Y" if the medical history records type 2 diabetes mellitus at screening, else "N" (medical history not included in this teaching dataset).

columns.name: SBPBL
columns.label: Baseline Seated Systolic BP (mmHg)
columns.derivation: ADVS.AVAL where PARAMCD = "SYSBP" and ABLFL = "Y" (Day 1 pre-dose value, mean of 3 seated readings).

columns.name: DBPBL
columns.label: Baseline Seated Diastolic BP (mmHg)
columns.derivation: ADVS.AVAL where PARAMCD = "DIABP" and ABLFL = "Y".

columns.name: SBPGR1
columns.label: Baseline SBP Group 1
columns.derivation: "<150 mmHg" if SBPBL < 150; ">=150 mmHg" otherwise. Derived from the analysis baseline — compare with STRAT1R (stratum as randomized).

columns.name: SBPGR1N
columns.label: Baseline SBP Group 1 (N)
columns.derivation: 1 if SBPGR1 = "<150 mmHg"; 2 otherwise.

columns.name: STRAT1R
columns.label: Stratum 1 as Randomized
columns.derivation: Baseline SBP stratum recorded in the IxRS at randomization ("<150 mmHg" / ">=150 mmHg"). Three subjects were stratified in error (STRAT1R differs from SBPGR1).

columns.name: STRAT1RN
columns.label: Stratum 1 as Randomized (N)
columns.derivation: 1 if STRAT1R = "<150 mmHg"; 2 otherwise.

columns.name: RANDNO
columns.label: Randomization Number
columns.derivation: Stratum number × 1000 + sequence within stratum (from the IxRS randomization list).

columns.name: TRT01P
columns.label: Planned Treatment for Period 01
columns.derivation: Treatment assigned by the IxRS: "Placebo", "VTX-221 10 mg" or "VTX-221 20 mg" (permuted blocks of 6 within stratum, 1:1:1).

columns.name: TRT01PN
columns.label: Planned Treatment for Period 01 (N)
columns.derivation: 0 = Placebo, 1 = VTX-221 10 mg, 2 = VTX-221 20 mg.

columns.name: TRT01A
columns.label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
columns.derivation: Equal to TRT01P for treated subjects (no dispensing errors occurred); missing for subjects never dosed.

columns.name: TRT01AN
columns.label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
columns.derivation: Numeric code of TRT01A.

columns.name: RANDDT
columns.label: Date of Randomization
columns.notes: ISO 8601 text in the CSV; a SAS dataset would store a numeric date with a DATE9. format.

columns.name: TRTSDT
columns.label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
columns.derivation: Date of first dose. First dose is taken on Day 1, the randomization day. Missing if never dosed.

columns.name: TRTEDT
columns.label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
columns.derivation: Date of last dose (dosing diary). Completers: the day before the Week 12 trough visit. Missing if never dosed.

columns.name: TRTDURD
columns.label: Total Treatment Duration (Days)
columns.derivation: TRTEDT − TRTSDT + 1.

columns.name: COMPLPCT
columns.label: Treatment Compliance (%)
columns.derivation: 100 × tablets taken / tablets expected over the treatment period, from drug accountability (accountability records are not included — simplification).

columns.name: EOSSTT
columns.label: End of Study Status
columns.derivation: "COMPLETED" if the subject attended the Week 12 visit; otherwise "DISCONTINUED".

columns.name: EOSDT
columns.label: End of Study Date
columns.derivation: Completers: Week 12 visit date. Discontinued: early-termination date, or last visit date for subjects lost to follow-up.

columns.name: DCSREAS
columns.label: Reason for Discontinuation from Study
columns.derivation: Primary reason recorded on the disposition CRF; missing for completers.

columns.name: ITTFL
columns.label: Intent-To-Treat Population Flag
columns.derivation: "Y" for every randomized subject (analyzed as randomized).

columns.name: SAFFL
columns.label: Safety Population Flag
columns.derivation: "Y" if the subject took at least one dose of study drug (TRTSDT not missing).

columns.name: PPROTFL
columns.label: Per-Protocol Population Flag
columns.derivation: "Y" if ITTFL = "Y", SAFFL = "Y", COMPLFL = "Y" and 80 <= COMPLPCT <= 120 (SAP rule for this teaching study).

columns.name: COMPLFL
columns.label: Completers Population Flag
columns.derivation: "Y" if EOSSTT = "COMPLETED" (Week 12 visit attended).

datasets.name: ADVS
datasets.label: Vital Signs Analysis Dataset
datasets.structure: BDS: one record per subject, parameter and assessment
datasets.description: Seated systolic (SYSBP) and diastolic (DIABP) blood pressure at screening, baseline (Day 1) and Weeks 2, 4, 8 and 12, plus early-termination and unscheduled assessments, with analysis windows (AVISIT), baseline, change from baseline and a one-record-per-visit analysis flag (ANL01FL).

columns.name: SITEID
columns.label: Study Site Identifier
columns.derivation: ADSL.SITEID.

columns.name: TRTP
columns.label: Planned Treatment
columns.derivation: ADSL.TRT01P (single-period study).

columns.name: TRTPN
columns.label: Planned Treatment (N)
columns.derivation: ADSL.TRT01PN: 0 = Placebo, 1 = VTX-221 10 mg, 2 = VTX-221 20 mg.

columns.name: ITTFL
columns.label: Intent-To-Treat Population Flag
columns.derivation: ADSL.ITTFL.

columns.name: PARAM
columns.label: Parameter
columns.derivation: "Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)" or "Diastolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)".

columns.name: PARAMN
columns.label: Parameter (N)
columns.derivation: 1 = SYSBP, 2 = DIABP.

columns.name: VISIT
columns.label: Visit Name
columns.derivation: Collected visit: SCREENING, BASELINE, WEEK 2, WEEK 4, WEEK 8, WEEK 12, EARLY TERMINATION or UNSCHEDULED.

columns.name: VISITNUM
columns.label: Visit Number
columns.derivation: SCREENING 1, BASELINE 2, WEEK 2 3, WEEK 4 4, WEEK 8 5, WEEK 12 6, EARLY TERMINATION 99; UNSCHEDULED = preceding scheduled VISITNUM + 0.01 (a common convention, not a CDISC rule).

columns.name: AVISIT
columns.label: Analysis Visit
columns.derivation: SCREENING and BASELINE as collected. Post-baseline records are assigned by ADY to analysis windows: WEEK 2 = Days 2–21, WEEK 4 = Days 22–42, WEEK 8 = Days 43–70, WEEK 12 = Days 71–99 (so early-termination and unscheduled records get an analysis visit).

columns.name: AVISITN
columns.label: Analysis Visit (N)
columns.derivation: SCREENING -1, BASELINE 0, then the week number (2, 4, 8, 12).

columns.name: ADT
columns.label: Analysis Date
columns.derivation: Date of the blood-pressure assessment.

columns.name: ADY
columns.label: Analysis Relative Day
columns.derivation: ADT − TRTSDT + 1 if ADT >= TRTSDT, else ADT − TRTSDT (no Day 0). For the two never-dosed subjects RANDDT is the reference date.

columns.name: AVAL
columns.label: Analysis Value
columns.derivation: Mean of three seated readings taken at the visit, rounded to 0.1 mmHg (individual readings not included).

columns.name: BASE
columns.label: Baseline Value
columns.derivation: AVAL of the record with ABLFL = "Y" for the same USUBJID and PARAMCD.

columns.name: CHG
columns.label: Change from Baseline
columns.derivation: AVAL − BASE for post-baseline records (AVISITN > 0); missing for screening and baseline records (sponsor convention).

columns.name: PCHG
columns.label: Percent Change from Baseline
columns.derivation: 100 × CHG / BASE, rounded to 2 decimals; post-baseline records only.

columns.name: ABLFL
columns.label: Baseline Record Flag
columns.derivation: "Y" on the last non-missing value on or before first dose (Day 1 pre-dose); for never-dosed subjects, on or before RANDDT.

columns.name: ANL01FL
columns.label: Analysis Flag 01
columns.derivation: "Y" on the baseline record and on one record per subject, parameter and post-baseline AVISIT: the record closest to the target day (15, 29, 57, 85); ties go to the later record. Blank for screening and for records not selected.

datasets.name: AE
datasets.label: Adverse Events
datasets.structure: Events: one record per adverse event per subject
datasets.description: SDTM-like adverse events for treated subjects (plus a few events that started between screening and the first dose). Join to ADSL on USUBJID for treatment and population flags.

columns.name: AESEQ
columns.label: Sequence Number
columns.derivation: Sequential within USUBJID after sorting by AESTDTC, AEDECOD.

columns.name: AETERM
columns.label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event
columns.notes: Verbatim text as entered at the site (varies in case and wording).

columns.name: AEDECOD
columns.label: Dictionary-Derived Term
columns.notes: MedDRA-like preferred term, illustrative only (US spelling, no MedDRA codes).

columns.name: AEBODSYS
columns.label: Body System or Organ Class
columns.notes: MedDRA-like system organ class, illustrative only.

columns.name: AEREL
columns.label: Causality
columns.notes: Sponsor-defined two-level scale (RELATED / NOT RELATED); CDISC does not publish a single codelist for causality.

columns.name: EPOCH
columns.label: Epoch
columns.derivation: "SCREENING" if AESTDTC is before the first dose, else "TREATMENT".

columns.name: AESTDTC
columns.label: Start Date/Time of Adverse Event
columns.notes: Complete ISO 8601 dates in this teaching dataset (no partial dates).

columns.name: AEENDTC
columns.label: End Date/Time of Adverse Event
columns.notes: Missing when the event was ongoing at the end of the subject's participation.

columns.name: AESTDY
columns.label: Study Day of Start of Adverse Event
columns.derivation: AESTDTC − RFSTDTC + 1 if on/after RFSTDTC (first dose), else AESTDTC − RFSTDTC (no Day 0).

columns.name: AEENDY
columns.label: Study Day of End of Adverse Event
columns.derivation: Same rule as AESTDY applied to AEENDTC.
